description: This file implements a ThunderJS module for WebSocket communication, including connection management, request handling, event listening, and plugin registration.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection with specified options, manages socket events.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request over WebSocket and handles the response.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers event listeners with automatic disposal management.

methods.name: registerPlugin
methods.description: Registers a plugin with the ThunderJS instance.
